page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-8-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n server family. It features 8 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 62.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include graphics processing units (GPUs), with a GPU count of zero, and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is configured as none.

Operating with dedicated CPU allocation, the instance ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention from other tenants. The high memory density relative to the vCPU count makes this configuration qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without the need to scale up to higher vCPU tiers. No benchmark data is available to evaluate specific processing or memory throughput speeds.

Due to its memory-to-core ratio of nearly 1:8, this server is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration or local storage. Appropriate use cases include medium-sized databases, in-memory caching systems, data buffering, and enterprise applications that demand a larger memory footprint per compute unit.
